# Superseded v7 artifacts

The `*_v7*` artifacts in this directory are retained only as an audit trail.
They were produced before the P0 fidelity fixes and are not paper-comparable.
Use artifacts generated by `run_main_cases.sh`, which writes `*_lit1*` outputs.

## v8 (halted, superseded by lit1)

The v8 batch ran the extended model under script-imposed solver budgets and
halted at its first case: `fwd_subtiled_v8.json` records status `unknown`
(SCIP timelimit at II=1033 under `--ilp-seconds 240`). These files
(`fwd_subtiled_v8.*`, `run_main_cases_environment.log`) are preserved as
evidence of the superseded extended+budgeted regime, and remain in the working
tree at the pre-literalization baseline D113349666. The canonical literal
batch writes `*_lit1` stems via the revised `run_main_cases.sh`; the lit1
series marks the semantic break to the literal single-model regime.
